title: Example 1: text + audio over CBOR

source.note: composed from a verbatim example: Example 1 is printed as Python pseudo-code, so it has no bytes to copy. Every field name, value and order is the example's; the audio payload `b'\x52\x49\x46\x46...'` is truncated there and is composed here as exactly the four bytes it shows, 52 49 46 46 ("RIFF"). The CBOR is produced by conformance/tools/cbor_encode.py from the same JSON description, with definite-length map and array heads and the field names in the order printed.

submessages.label: transcription
submessages.content: What's the weather in Austin tomorrow?

expect.text: What's the weather in Austin tomorrow?

notes: `structured` with subformat `application/json` is a media type, not one of Table 1's json/uri/xml/html or a programming language, so a Warning is expected — on the standard's own example. The PascalCase field names are the example's, and exercise §5 case-insensitivity over the CBOR wire too.
